title: Epic - First Semester
plot_overview: A middle-class student studying abroad because of family expectations navigates romance, identity, and the challenges of growing up. His experiences invite an honest, emotionally focused exploration of self-understanding, personal change, and the pressures that shape his journey away from home.
will_you_like_this: You may like this if you enjoy sincere coming-of-age stories about romance, identity, and family expectations; Not for you if you prefer action-driven plots or high-concept drama.
review_summary: Pros: emotionally honest; relatable coming-of-age; thoughtful themes | Cons: limited review context; may feel familiar
